arxiv-2006-00888.title: ValueNet: A Natural Language-to-SQL System that Learns from Database Information
arxiv-2006-00888.creator: Ursin Brunner, Kurt Stockinger
arxiv-2006-00888.description: Abstract Building natural language (NL) interfaces for databases has been a long-standing challenge for several decades. The major advantage of these so-called NL-to-SQL systems is that end-users can query complex databases without the need to know SQL or the underlying database schema.

arxiv-2111-02326.title: End-to-End Annotator Bias Approximation on Crowdsourced Single-Label Sentiment Analysis
arxiv-2111-02326.creator: Gerhard Hagerer, David Szabo, Andreas Koch, Maria Luisa Ripoll Dominguez, Maximilian Wich, Hannah Danner, Georg Groh
arxiv-2111-02326.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Gerhard Hagerer, David Szabo, Andreas Koch, Maria Luisa Ripoll Dominguez, Maximilian Wich, Hannah Danner, Georg Groh. Sentiment analysis is often a crowdsourcing task prone to subjective labels given by many annotators. It is not yet fully understood how the annotation bias of each annotator can be modeled correctly with state-of-the-art methods. However, resolving annotator bias precisely and reliably is the key to understand annotators’ labeling behavior and to successfully resolve corresponding individual misconceptions and wrongdoings regarding the annotation task.

arxiv-2112-02729.title: Facial Emotion Characterization and Detection using Fourier Transform and Machine Learning
arxiv-2112-02729.creator: Aishwarya Gouru, Shan Suthaharan
arxiv-2112-02729.description: Abstract We present a Fourier-based machine learning technique that characterizes and detects facial emotions. The main challenging task in the development of machine learning (ML) models for classifying facial emotions is the detection of accurate emotional features from a set of training samples, and the generation of feature vectors for constructing a meaningful feature space and building ML models.

arxiv-2206-08446.title: Methods for Estimating and Improving Robustness of Language Models
arxiv-2206-08446.creator: Michal Štefánik
arxiv-2206-08446.description: Abstract Despite their outstanding performance, large language models (LLMs) suffer notorious flaws related to their preference for simple, surface-level textual relations over full semantic complexity of the problem. This proposal investigates a common denominator of this problem in their weak ability to generalise outside of the training domain.

arxiv-2307-08187.title: An Empirical Study of Pre-trained Model Selection for Out-of-Distribution Generalization and Calibration
arxiv-2307-08187.creator: Hiroki Naganuma † \dagger, Ryuichiro Hataya † \dagger, Kotaro Yoshida, Ioannis Mitliagkas naganuma.hiroki@mila.quebec, ryuichiro.hataya@riken.jp, yoshida.k.0253@m.isct.ac.jp, ioannis@mila.quebec,
arxiv-2307-08187.description: Abstract In the field of computer vision, fine-tuning pre-trained models has become a prevalent strategy for out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization tasks. Different from most prior work that has focused on advancing learning algorithms, we systematically examined how pre-trained model size, pre-training dataset size, and training strategies impact generalization and confidence calibration on downstream tasks.

arxiv-2309-07287.title: Enhancing Child Vocalization Classification with Phonetically-Tuned Embeddings for Assisting Autism Diagnosis
arxiv-2309-07287.creator: Jialu Li, Mark Hasegawa-Johnson, Karrie Karahalios
arxiv-2309-07287.description: Abstract The assessment of children at risk of autism typically involves a clinician observing, taking notes, and rating children’s behaviors. A machine learning model that can label adult and child audio may largely save labor in coding children’s behaviors, helping clinicians capture critical events and better communicate with parents. In this study, we leverage Wav2Vec 2.

arxiv-2310-17082.title: Does or did the supernova remnant Cassiopeia A operate as a PeVatron? Journal: ApJL
arxiv-2310-17082.creator: Zhen Cao, F. Aharonian, Q. An, Axikegu, Y.X. Bai, Y.W. Bao, D. Bastieri, X.J. Bi, Y.J. Bi, J.T. Cai, Q. Cao, W.Y. Cao, Zhe Cao, J. Chang, J.F. Chang, A.M. Chen, E.S. Chen, Liang Chen, Lin Chen, Long Chen, M.J. Chen, M.L. Chen, Q.H. Chen, S.H. Chen, S.Z. Chen, T.L. Chen, Y. Chen, N. Cheng, Y.D. Cheng
arxiv-2310-17082.description: Abstract For decades, supernova remnants (SNRs) have been considered the prime sources of Galactic Cosmic rays (CRs). But whether SNRs can accelerate CR protons to PeV energies and thus dominate CR flux up to the knee is currently under intensive theoretical and phenomenological debate.

arxiv-2311-06193.title: The Density Formula: One Lemma to Bound Them All
arxiv-2311-06193.creator: Michael Kaufmann, Boris Klemz, Kristin Knorr, Meghana M. Reddy, Felix Schröder, Torsten Ueckerdt
arxiv-2311-06193.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Michael Kaufmann, Boris Klemz, Kristin Knorr, Meghana M. Reddy, Felix Schröder, Torsten Ueckerdt. We introduce the Density Formula for (topological) drawings of graphs in the plane or on the sphere, which relates the number of edges, vertices, crossings, and sizes of cells in the drawing.

arxiv-2311-08335.title: Distinguishing immunological and behavioral effects of vaccination
arxiv-2311-08335.creator: Mats Stensrud, Daniel Nevo, Uri Obolski
arxiv-2311-08335.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Mats Stensrud, Daniel Nevo, Uri Obolski. The interpretation of vaccine efficacy estimands is subtle, even in randomized trials designed to quantify immunological effects of vaccination. In this article, we introduce terminology to distinguish between different vaccine efficacy estimands and clarify their interpretations. This allows us to explicitly consider immunological and behavioural effects of vaccination, and establish that policy-relevant estimands can differ substantially from those commonly reported in vaccine trials.

arxiv-2404-03898.title: VoltaVision: A Transfer Learning model for electronic component classification
arxiv-2404-03898.creator: Anas Mohammad Ishfaqul Muktadir Osmani, Taimur Rahman & Salekul Islam
arxiv-2404-03898.description: Abstract In this paper, we analyze the effectiveness of transfer learning on classifying electronic components. Transfer learning reuses pre-trained models to save time and resources in building a robust classifier rather than learning from scratch. Our work introduces a lightweight CNN, coined as VoltaVision, and compares its performance against more complex models.

arxiv-2412-05541.title: Isochronous and period-doubling diagrams for symplectic maps of the plane
arxiv-2412-05541.creator: T. Zolkin, S. Nagaitsev, I. Morozov, S. Kladov, Y-K. Kim
arxiv-2412-05541.description: Abstract Symplectic mappings of the plane serve as key models for exploring the fundamental nature of complex behavior in nonlinear systems. Central to this exploration is the effective visualization of stability regimes, which enables the interpretation of how systems evolve under varying conditions.

arxiv-2502-12622.title: Generative AI Enabled Robust Data Augmentation for Wireless Sensing in ISAC Networks Thanks: Jiacheng Wang, Changyuan Zhao, and Dusit Niyato are with the College of Computing and Data Science, Nanyang Technological University, Singapore (e-mail: jiacheng.wang@ntu.edu.sg, zhao0441@e.ntu.edu.sg, dniya

arxiv-2502-12622.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Jiacheng Wang, Changyuan Zhao, Hongyang Du, Geng Sun, Jiawen Kang. Integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) uses the same software and hardware resources to achieve both communication and sensing functionalities. Thus, it stands as one of the core technologies of 6G and has garnered significant attention in recent years. In ISAC systems, a variety of machine learning models are trained to analyze and identify signal patterns, thereby ensuring reliable sensing and communications.

arxiv-2503-01982.title: Forming the local starburst galaxy Haro 11 through hydrodynamical merger simulations
arxiv-2503-01982.creator: Timmy Ejdetjärn, Oscar Agertz, Florent Renaud, Göran Östlin, Alexandra Le Reste, Angela Adamo
arxiv-2503-01982.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Timmy Ejdetjärn, Oscar Agertz, Florent Renaud, Göran Östlin, Alexandra Le Reste, Angela Adamo. Haro 11 is a metal-poor, starburst galaxy believed to be the result of an ongoing merger, which is shaping the properties of the galaxy. In this study, we carry out a large suite of numerical simulations of a merger between two disc galaxies, to study possible origins of Haro 11 and understand under which conditions various features of the galaxy are formed.

pmc-11313635.title: The Relationship between Placental Shear Wave Elastography and Fetal Weight—A Prospective Study
pmc-11313635.creator: Erika Cavanagh, Kylie Crawford, Jesrine Gek Shan Hong, Davide Fontanarosa, Christopher Edwards, Marie-Luise Wille, Jennifer Hong, Vicki L. Clifton, Sailesh Kumar

pmc-11314281.title: Salt Reduction and Iodine Fortification Policies Are Compatible: Perspectives for Public Health Advocacy
pmc-11314281.creator: Jessica Rigutto-Farebrother, Michael B Zimmermann, Caterina Mian, Simona Censi
pmc-11314281.description: Cardiovascular diseases account for almost 18 million deaths annually, the most of all non-communicable diseases. The reduction of dietary salt consumption is a modifiable risk factor. The WHO recommends a daily sodium intake of <2000 mg but average consumption exceeds this in many countries globally.

pmc-11467004.title: Odour characterisation of recycled HDPE in different washing and processing processes
pmc-11467004.creator: Juan López Martínez, Jesús Manuel Rodríguez Rego, Laura Mendoza Cerezo, María Dolores Samper Madrigal, Antonio Macías-García
pmc-11467004.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). The waste of polymeric materials in our society is increasing year after year, generating a serious pollution problem. One way to deal with this waste problem is to recycle and reuse these materials. This process of recovery of used plastic materials aims to minimise their impact on the environment and reduce the energy consumption required for the generation of new consumer products.

pmc-11478798.title: Cardiovascular health of women 10 to 20 years after placenta-related pregnancy diseases considering the possible effect of pentaerythrityl tetranitrate treatment during pregnancy on long-term maternal cardiovascular health (PAVA study)
pmc-11478798.creator: Charlotte Lößner, Anna Multhaup, Laura Bäz, Thomas Lehmann, Yvonne Heimann, Ekkehard Schleußner, Marcus Franz, Tanja Groten, Edina Cenko, Edina Cenko, Edina Cenko
pmc-11478798.description: BackgroundWomen developing preeclampsia (PE) or fetal growth restriction (FGR) during pregnancy are at higher risk for cardiovascular diseases (CVD) later in life. We aimed to analyse cardiovascular health of women 10–20 years after affected pregnancies in comparison to women after uneventful pregnancies. In addition, we assessed a potential long-term effect of the NO-donor pentaerythrityl tetranitrate (PETN).

pmc-11584394.title: Rethinking natural hazards research and engagement to include co-creation with Indigenous communities
pmc-11584394.creator: Thomas J Jones, Harry Nyce, Yannick Le Moigne, Glyn Williams-Jones, Deanna Nyce
pmc-11584394.description: Indigenous peoples are widely affected by natural hazards and their history and knowledge can directly inform on past events and mitigation strategies. Here we show how effective co-creation of resources and bi-lateral knowledge exchange between natural hazard researchers and local Indigenous communities provides an effective, equitable, and sustainable way to conduct research.
